items.title: Preserve Verdict Alarm Marker in Backend 🚨
items.summary: This update ensures that the existing 'agent produced no verdict' marker is retained when structured output is missing. A regression test has been added to link the runner failure path to the deployed CLS alarm query, maintaining alert coverage without altering the successful agent path. All tests have passed successfully.

items.title: Enhance Risk Verdicts with Structured Output in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update requires the Claude CLI to return signup-risk verdicts in a structured format, improving clarity and reliability. The legacy verdict file is retained as a fallback, while output from failed runs is now rejected. Additional tests have been implemented to ensure the integrity of the output contract.

items.title: Enhance Message Handling in Platform Service 🤖
items.summary: This update refines the message normalization process by making it capability-profile driven, improving the handling of unsupported message controls. Key changes include the consolidation of alias routing and facade profiles, and the preservation of native model passthrough while rejecting only malformed requests. Comprehensive testing confirms that all functionalities are intact and performance is optimized.

items.title: Enhance Document Visibility Handling in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of document visibility by ensuring that the default visibility is inherited based on the document's privacy status. The changes prevent private documents from being mistakenly marked as visible and ensure that the serializer correctly reflects the intended visibility. All tests have passed, confirming the stability of the implementation.

items.title: Release coding agent contracts in Common Frontend 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps the `@acedatacloud/core` package to version 0.20.0, ensuring that the merged `./coding-agent` subpath is now published for both Nexior and PlatformFrontend. The TypeScript build and 92 Vitest tests have successfully passed, and the package lock has been updated accordingly. Consumers will remain on version 0.19.1 until they choose to upgrade.

items.title: Enhance Deployment Status Reporting in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the `deployment-status` accurately reflects a terminal `reclaimed` state when resources are deleted. It also clears stale replicas, pods, and access URLs from the response, while preserving audit metadata. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate the new behavior and ensure reliability.

items.title: Enhance billing guard for reclaimed deployments in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a safeguard to prevent the renewal of deployments that have been reclaimed, ensuring that no payments can be processed without available resources. Key changes include the addition of validation logic in the order creation process and the implementation of focused tests to verify this behavior. The superuser path remains intact for operational compensations.

items.title: Enhance WeChat Security Verification in Wisdom 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a dedicated security-code form to the Wisdom login page, improving the user experience during WeChat security verification. It eliminates the need for QR codes when WeChat reports a security verification status and streamlines the verification process through the existing API. Additionally, the UI now maintains transitional login states, enhancing clarity for users.

items.title: Enhance SERP with Solana x402 Wallet Payments in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces Solana x402 wallet payments to the synchronous SERP scenario, allowing for seamless wallet quotes and signed searches. Key changes include a unified request builder for quotes and submissions, while maintaining Vuex state management for error handling and payment cancellations. The implementation has been validated with comprehensive testing and linting, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Fix invoice order sorting issue in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update resolves a critical issue where the `_notify_invoice_issued` function was using a non-existent `created_at` field for sorting `InvoiceOrder`. The sorting has been corrected to use the actual related field `order__created_at` and `order_id`. Additionally, new tests have been added to ensure the integrity of the ORM paths and prevent similar issues in the future.

items.title: Enhance Wallet Payments for Kling and Digital Human in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces Solana x402 wallet payments for Kling video generation, Kling talking-photo, Digital Human video generation, and voice cloning. Each endpoint now operates independently with its own quote and payload management, enhancing user experience while maintaining safety protocols. The changes ensure that Kling Motion remains Credits-only due to unpredictable output durations.

items.title: Enhance Coding Agent Contracts in Common Frontend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `@acedatacloud/core/coding-agent` module, featuring stable action/event constants and DTOs for coding agents. Key functionalities include session management, streaming helpers, and rendering limits, all while maintaining app ownership of stores and routers. The changes are validated with comprehensive tests and are designed for seamless integration with Nexior and PlatformFrontend.

items.title: Disable Dynamic Exact Payments for Specific APIs in Backend 🚫
items.summary: This update removes Kling Motion and Seedream from the Solana exact x402 allowlist due to their inability to provide final billable usage at authorization time. The changes ensure that both endpoints are excluded from dynamic exact payments, enhancing the reliability of billing processes. Validation tests have confirmed that the modifications are functioning as intended.

items.title: Enhance Session Hosting Capabilities in Coding Bridge 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the `coding_bridge.embed.SessionHost`, enabling servers to host Coding Bridge sessions using their own WebSocket/JWT transport. Key features include reusing the existing session registry and implementing provider allowlisting. Additionally, a commercial license option is added while maintaining AGPL-3.0-or-later for public users.

items.title: Enhance text-only message handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new capability-scoped descriptor for `message_content_formats`, allowing for the normalization of text-only message content. It collapses lossless text-only block arrays into strings while preserving other content types. The implementation is currently disabled unless explicitly declared, ensuring backward compatibility.

items.title: Enhance Invoice Email Details in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update refines the invoice success email by removing the internal UUID and including the billing title, amount, and associated order numbers. Multiple orders are now displayed in the order of their creation, enhancing clarity for users. Additionally, a new migration has been added to update the webhook payload safely, ensuring a smooth transition and rollback capability.

items.title: Designing an Internal Debug Agent in Index 🤖
items.summary: This update introduces a design for a single-pod internal Claude Code debug workspace, enhancing the development environment without altering runtime code. Key changes include embedding the `coding-bridge` Python package and defining explicit implementation gates for licensing decisions. The new documentation outlines the structure and goals for the debug agent, ensuring a streamlined approach to debugging and testing.

items.title: Finalize legal page overrides for white-label plans in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a dedicated configuration for Site Terms & Privacy, moving away from the generic Documents UI. Key changes include the addition of a backend-rendered default template and support for custom Markdown overrides, enhancing localization capabilities. The existing white-label plan has been updated with new evidence and validation results, ensuring consistency across the platform.

items.title: Enhance x402 Discount Breakdown in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a detailed breakdown of the x402 discount, showcasing the normal-weight paid USDC, a struck-through list price, and an ACE/manual discount badge. Additionally, it modifies the transaction link placement and retains essential metadata for settlement status and business tags, ensuring legacy-row compatibility. The changes enhance user experience by providing clearer financial information.

items.title: Enhance x402 Quote Discounts in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the ability to show frozen usage discounts on x402 quotes, ensuring ACE discounts are applied before signing. Key changes include improved display of paid USDC with discount badges and a refined layout for transaction actions. Additionally, legacy rows are now accurately represented without inferred pricing.

items.title: Enhance Site Legal Settings in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a dedicated 'Terms & Privacy' settings tab, allowing users to manage legal texts separately from the generic Documents UI. Users can now choose between default content or fully custom Markdown for both Terms and Privacy, with features like editing, safe previews, and localization support. The implementation reuses existing operators and ensures localization across all 11 UI locales, enhancing the overall user experience.

items.title: Comprehensive Research on China Digital Invoice Providers in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a detailed study on digital invoice providers in China, featuring a comparison of 16 suppliers including Tencent and Kingdee. Key additions include a POC readiness matrix, vendor decision cards, and a recommended provider-adapter architecture. The documentation has been corrected to reflect the current state of the invoice system and includes a generated PDF for easy reference.

items.title: Enhance x402 Discount Contract Logic in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update extends the x402 discount contract by locking atomic fields and updating frozen discount metadata to strings. It ensures that list responses continue to hide request/response details while exposing sanitized payloads. No changes were made to the production model, serializer, or migrations.

items.title: Link Revenue Orders to Users in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the admin revenue table by displaying user IDs for each order, allowing for easy navigation to user details. It includes deep-linking to the existing admin user query while ensuring that stale query responses do not disrupt the current user view. Additionally, the navigation contract has been added to the prebuild test suite, ensuring robust functionality.

items.title: Enable x402 Usage Discounts in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update enables identity-bound x402 usage discounts following the successful rollout of compatibility with 5/5 replicas. The change is isolated to a single deployment environment variable, ensuring a smooth transition. The deployment YAML has been verified and parses successfully, with the necessary adjustments made to support this feature.

items.title: Enhance Document Overrides with Localization Features in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces localized document body overrides by extending the existing SiteDocumentOverride model with new fields for content mode and markdown. The API now returns locale-aware content, enhancing user experience for legal documents like Terms and Privacy. Comprehensive tests ensure stability and compliance with safety measures, including limits on raw HTML and markdown content length.

items.title: Implement Frozen Usage Discounts in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces frozen usage discounts for the dedicated x402 host, allowing for a more controlled billing process. Key changes include the freezing of existing ConsumptionDiscounts and the addition of a new pricing module to handle these discounts. The rollout is designed to ensure safety with a default disabled flag, requiring a two-phase deployment approach.

items.title: Enhance Video Wallet Payments in Nexior 🎥
items.summary: This update introduces Solana x402 wallet payment support across 12 standard video scenarios, including Luma, Pika, and Maestro. Key changes include maintaining authoritative request builders and supporting guest task polling without altering existing storage or behavior. The UI is controlled by a feature flag, ensuring a smooth rollout.

items.title: Enhance Branding Localization Features in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces an auto-translation toggle for branding content, including company and customer service labels. It ensures that the editor hydrates from the branding source while preserving nested data during saves. Additionally, it binds contacts to stable IDs and maintains input consistency when toggling auto-translation, enhancing user experience and data integrity.

items.title: New Email Notification for Invoice Issuance in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new internal SMTP notification system that alerts users upon successful invoice issuance. Key changes include the addition of a durable `invoice.issued` event and a dedicated endpoint for sending emails, ensuring seamless communication without modifying existing endpoints. The implementation enhances the transactional email process, making it more efficient and reliable.

items.title: Enhance API Domain Previews for Custom Domains in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update allows previews to run on a specified custom API domain by passing the Active API-domain host as the base URL for live requests. Existing functionality remains intact for callers that do not specify a `requestBaseUrl`. Key components have been modified to support this feature, ensuring a seamless integration for users.

items.title: Enhance CORS Handling for Custom Domains in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the upstream wildcard CORS header with the requesting portal origin for custom API-domain responses. It also ensures that the Caddy API proxy is applied and restarted during Gateway deployments, improving deployment reliability. Additionally, new regression tests have been added to validate the changes and ensure fast failure on configuration issues.

items.title: Enhance AI chat usage record retries in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of transient errors in the AI chat usage recording process. Key changes include implementing a retry mechanism for network errors and HTTP 5xx responses, while preserving the initial delay for database interactions. Comprehensive tests have confirmed the functionality, ensuring robust performance and reliability.

items.title: Unify Success Feedback for Copy Actions in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update introduces a shared CircleCheck copy control across all frontends, streamlining the user experience. It replaces duplicated OAuth list and credential copy states, ensuring consistent feedback with a 3-second reset. Additionally, localized copy-failure messages have been added for all 18 supported languages, enhancing accessibility.

items.title: Unify Copy Success Feedback in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update standardizes the copy success feedback across various components, including CircleCheck and tooltip messages. Key changes include a consistent 3-second reset for feedback, improved accessibility with aria labels, and stable layouts for text-button and code-block controls. The modifications enhance user experience by ensuring reliable feedback for copy actions throughout the application.

items.title: Unify Copy Success Feedback in Nexior 🎉
items.summary: This update standardizes the success feedback for copy actions across various components in Nexior, including CircleCheck and chat sharing. Key changes include a consistent 3-second reset for feedback, suppression of false success messages, and removal of legacy code. The improvements enhance user experience by providing clear and accessible feedback during copy actions.

items.title: Enhance Logo and Favicon Studio in Nexior 🎨
items.summary: This update introduces a two-step smart Logo/Favicon studio to Site settings, allowing for improved logo management with light and dark variants. Default logos are now set to color-on-light and white-on-dark, while flat favicon backgrounds have been removed in favor of a single transparent color favicon. Additionally, real translations have been added across all generated locales, enhancing accessibility for users worldwide.

items.title: Enhance logo and favicon handling in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update improves the handling of adaptive logos and favicons by ensuring transparent logos maintain their smart-adaptive appearance. It decouples dark-mode variants from background removal and processes favicons through a consistent background analysis flow, preserving only the transparent color asset. Additionally, the favicon output is now optimized for high-DPI displays.

items.title: Enhance Site Branding Localization in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update extends the translation capabilities for site branding content, allowing localization of company, copyright, and contact labels. A new command for backfilling stable contact UUIDs has been introduced, along with improvements to preserve translation states during updates. CI coverage has also been expanded to ensure robust testing of the new features.

items.title: Enhance Support Page with Branded Banner in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update introduces a sleek, compact dark banner to the support page, aligning with the existing Models and X402 hero language. The design maintains a professional aesthetic with a consistent title scale and ensures compatibility across both light and dark themes. All existing content remains intact, enhancing the visual appeal without introducing new assets.

items.title: Streamline API Relations by Removing Legacy Foreign Key in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the legacy `app_api.service_id` column following a successful M2M migration. It ensures that all APIs maintain a valid primary relation while preserving the `service` and `service_id` as read-only projections. The commit includes reversible SQL for potential rollback and has passed extensive validation checks.

items.title: Enhance API Selector Loading Experience in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update keeps the usage-history API selector visible while loading options, improving user experience. The dropdown now displays a loading state instead of a skeleton, ensuring a smoother interaction. Additionally, the behavior has been integrated into the existing prebuild contract gate.

items.title: Enhance API Selector Loading Experience in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the usage-history API selector remains visible while options are preloading, improving user experience. Instead of displaying a skeleton, a loading state is shown inside the dropdown. Additionally, a new Vitest source contract has been added to validate these changes.

items.title: Enhance Menu Localization and Order in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a unified sortable menu for both public and console navigation, allowing custom links to be prioritized over built-in ones while keeping admin-only links separate. Localization toggles have been added for each link, supported by raw zh-CN source projections and stable UUIDs. The changes enhance user experience by providing a more flexible and localized navigation structure.

items.title: Enhance Menu Localization and Order in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces stable custom-link UUIDs and allows mixed ordering for menu links in the Site navigation. A new localization endpoint has been added, enabling better management of menu translations while preserving existing functionality. The changes ensure compatibility with the old frontend and maintain atomic translation state across updates.

items.title: Enhance Thinking Summaries and Routing in Platform Service 🤖
items.summary: This update improves the routing of child Messages requests through the existing Responses bridge, enhancing compatibility and performance. It introduces support for various output configuration effort levels and ensures that replayable thinking signatures are preserved. Additionally, it enforces stricter validation for request parameters, improving overall service reliability.

items.title: Ensure MiniMax H3 CLI Matches Documentation in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update confirms that the MiniMax H3 CLI is fully aligned with the latest documentation updates. Key areas such as API contract coverage for video generation and task actions have been verified, ensuring compliance with the OpenAPI specifications. No source changes are needed as the current implementation already meets the required standards.

items.title: Enhance Service Icons for Consistency in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update ensures that the reusable service icon backfill mapping is complete for Claude Code, Codex, and Digital Human. The three `Service.icon_url` values have been applied directly to production without migration, utilizing CDN-hosted square icons for uniform catalog rendering. All changes were verified in production, confirming the expected outcomes.

items.title: Streamline API Service Management in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update removes the legacy `Api.service` mirror and all associated reads, simplifying the authorization rules to focus solely on enabled `ApiService` membership. It ensures that each API has exactly one enabled primary relation, enhancing data integrity and system performance. The cleanup has been validated with all tests passing, confirming no runtime issues remain.

items.title: Enhance Minimax Task Filters in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new task-list pagination and creation-time filters for the Minimax Docs. The MCP task interface now supports parameters like `limit`, `offset`, `created_at_min`, and `created_at_max`, improving task retrieval efficiency. Additionally, polling behavior has been optimized to reduce delays for terminal task statuses.

items.title: Enhance logo processing with adaptive dark mode in Backend 🎨
items.summary: This update introduces an `adaptive_dark` logo output that maintains saturated brand colors while adjusting low-chroma black and gray text. The existing `dark` mode remains available for monochrome use. Comprehensive testing has confirmed the effectiveness of these changes, ensuring a seamless transition for clients.

items.title: Expanded MiniMax H3 Integration Guides in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update enhances the MiniMax H3 video integration documentation by adding comprehensive guides on token setup, use-case selection, and detailed task actions. It also includes three production-grade case studies showcasing various video outputs and clarifies key concepts without implying face recognition. The changes aim to improve user understanding and streamline the integration process.

items.title: Simplify Coding Plan Architecture for Better Reuse in Index 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the extensive 1,077-line Coding-specific architecture documentation with a streamlined 257-line RFC focused on reuse. Coding is now modeled as a standard database Service with three Period Packages, leveraging existing features like remaining_amount, expired_at, and Gateway billing. Several complex components such as entitlement, Redis quota, and dedicated UI have been removed, resulting in a net reduction of nearly 820 lines in documentation without affecting implementation or production databases.

items.title: Enhance Payment Options with Flux and QR Wallets in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces Flux and QR wallet payment options to the x402 scenario selector, enhancing user experience by allowing direct server quotes and wallet submissions. Key components have been modified to retain selected pricing parameters, ensuring a seamless integration with existing functionalities. The changes have been validated with extensive testing, confirming stability and performance.

items.title: Enhance Bank Transfer Instructions in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update clarifies bank transfer instructions by prominently displaying the exact frozen amount and currency required. It also explains that mismatched amounts or currencies cannot be credited automatically and provides user-friendly ACH/Fedwire routing details. Additionally, real translations have been added across all locales to improve accessibility for users.

items.title: Streamline Bank Routing Details in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update normalizes and deduplicates Airwallex routing codes while ensuring the first-seen order is preserved. It also separates SWIFT/BIC codes into their dedicated field and enhances the system's tolerance for malformed routing shapes, preventing disruptions in order details. Comprehensive tests have been added to validate these changes.

items.title: Enhance Payment Gateways with Cost Certainty in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature to gate payments based on cost certainty by reading x402 eligibility from the existing metadata. It ensures that requests fail closed for any missing or malformed policies, while also preserving user-selected parameters for accurate cost quoting. Additionally, it implements mutually exclusive payment types and records reconciliation telemetry for better tracking.

items.title: Enhance API Playground Routing for White-Label Sites in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the routing for the white-label API playground by ensuring that document endpoint labels are routed through the verified `active_api_host`. It also standardizes the host used for generated snippets and live tests, preserving private deployment URLs. Additionally, the white-label document contract check has been updated to prevent discrepancies between display and execution.

items.title: Revamp Support Page Design in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update enhances the support page by replacing the dark graph-paper background with a light-first design and a more subtle brand wash. Key changes include a reduction of the support banner size, removal of misleading indicators, and the transformation of channels into compact responsive cards. The update maintains essential features like tenant-configured contacts and dark-mode support, ensuring a seamless user experience.

items.title: Enhance Period Package Support in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces support for Period package purchases by leveraging existing Period Applications. The changes allow for the selection of the appropriate application type based on the availability of Period packages, while maintaining the global recharge path for Usage Services. Key files modified include the service detail page and the addition of a new script for validation.

items.title: Enhance API Cost Management in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new explicit allowlist for request-priced x402 endpoints through the addition of `cost/x402_policy.json`. It ensures that all API policies are published atomically while maintaining existing metadata and cost rules. Validation has been successfully completed with over 1,000 tests passing, ensuring robust functionality without schema migrations.

items.title: Enhance Auto-Translate Toggle Spacing in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update improves the layout of the auto-translate toggle by removing the negative right margin that previously encroached on the character counter. A new 4px right margin has been added to ensure the toggle is fully visible and aesthetically pleasing. These changes enhance the overall user interface experience.

items.title: Enhance API Domain Playground Experience in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update replaces the static API-domain curl block with a reusable real-key and API picker, allowing for dynamic code generation against the active custom domain. It also improves global application initialization and updates the UI translations across all locales, enhancing user experience and accessibility.

items.title: Enhance Bank Transfer Control in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update allows the server-side `ENABLE_BANK_TRANSFER` flag to directly control visibility, removing the unrelated URL/cookie tester opt-in requirement. The low-amount flag and amount threshold are retained, ensuring that only targeted users can access this feature while maintaining safety measures. Validation checks have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of the changes.

items.title: Enhance Service Icon Handling in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update introduces a shared icon component for service overrides, ensuring consistent rendering across the application. It includes fallback initials for cases where icon data is missing or fails to load. Additionally, contract tests have been implemented to cover both table rows and the service picker, enhancing reliability.

items.title: Unify Markup Inputs as Percentages in Frontend Web 🎉
items.summary: This update standardizes site-wide markup inputs to percentage units, aligning them with per-service overrides. The conversion between percentage UI values and ratio API values now occurs only at the request boundary, enhancing clarity and usability. Additionally, all locale guidance has been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring consistency across the platform.

items.title: Restore API Service Type for Console Usages in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update fixes an issue where the API filter on the `/console/usages` page was not displaying options for APIs owned by `Api` services. The change includes adding `service.type` to the compact `/apis/` response and updating the test suite to ensure the integrity of this functionality. All related tests have passed successfully, confirming the fix.

items.title: Enhance Period Application Expiry Handling in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update enforces expiry checks for Period Applications, ensuring they are only rejected when they have an explicit expired_at date that has passed. Legacy Period Applications with a NULL expiry remain unaffected, preserving their unlimited status. The changes include new validation tests and adjustments to the application logic to maintain production stability.

items.title: Enhance YouTube Connector for Video Management in Backend 🎥
items.summary: This update introduces the `youtube.force-ssl` permission to the YouTube connector, allowing users to manage the visibility and deletion of their own videos. The permission is now exposed in the connection scope picker with clear descriptions. Additionally, new contract tests ensure that the permissions and requested scopes remain aligned, enhancing the overall functionality of the connector.

items.title: Enhance API Service Membership Handling in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces significant improvements to the API service membership management. Key changes include the separation of primary and entry memberships, the addition of a new ApiService model, and the implementation of feature-flagged membership authorization. These enhancements aim to streamline membership resolution and improve overall application behavior.

items.title: Tighten Service Name and Alias Spacing in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update removes the extra gap between service titles and aliases in the service customization list. It sets a compact line height to enhance the visual relationship between the two lines of text, specifically affecting only the first column of the table without impacting other lists or font sizes.

items.title: Enhance Airwallex Payment Alerts in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces stable CLS events for unmatched, possible-overpayment, and reversed Airwallex deposits. It also ensures that only normalized audit identifiers are logged after transaction commits and deduplicates alerts across webhook and reconciliation replays. These changes improve the reliability and clarity of payment processing notifications.

items.title: Align Gemini CLI with Updated OpenAPI in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the Gemini CLI with the latest changes in the OpenAPI contract. Key modifications include the removal of the unsupported `--cached-content` option and the restriction of `--video-url` to a single URL. Additionally, the README has been updated to reflect new commands and clarify the changes in API payloads.

items.title: Sync MCP servers with updated Docs in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update focuses on synchronizing the MCP servers with the latest changes in the Gemini Docs service. Key tasks include inspecting the repository layout, comparing the OpenAPI spec with the local implementation, and applying necessary sync changes. Additionally, contract tests have been added or updated, and targeted linting and testing have been performed to ensure quality.

items.title: Update Gemini Contract for Accurate Billing in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update aligns the Gemini contract with billable features by removing unsupported audio modalities and built-in tools from the public request schema. Key changes include the addition of an OpenAPI contract test and documentation of unsupported features, ensuring that the API responds with explicit errors for unsupported requests. The validation suite confirms that all tests pass, paving the way for a smooth rollout.

items.title: Enhance API Service Memberships in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new mechanism for reading services through memberships in the API. Key changes include switching to enabled `ApiService` memberships, refining API service filters, and exporting a stable `service_api_mapping.json`. The internal handling of raw M2M memberships has been improved for clarity and efficiency.

items.title: Revamp Invoice Upload Page for Dark Mode in Frontend Web 🌙
items.summary: This update enhances the invoice upload page by fixing the dark mode display issues. The AceData wordmark is now used consistently, replacing the previous CDN logo and redundant text. Additionally, the UI has been updated to utilize Element Plus theme tokens for better visual coherence across different themes.

items.title: Implement Fail Closed for Unbillable Gemini Features in Platform Service 🚫
items.summary: This update introduces a fail-closed mechanism for unbillable Gemini features, ensuring that requests for unsupported audio inputs and built-in tools return a 400 error before reaching the provider. Key changes include modifications to the GeminiHandler and the addition of validation tests to ensure compliance with billing protocols. The implementation aims to prevent incorrect billing for unsupported features while maintaining support for text and certain media types.

items.title: Updated AiChat Models with Latest Specs in M C Ps 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the AiChat model enums for Claude and Gemini with the latest OpenAPI specifications from upstream Docs. Key additions include several new Gemini models and enhanced contract coverage for model availability checks. The changes ensure that the AiChat server accurately reflects the current capabilities of these models.

items.title: Enhance API Service Relations in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new many-to-many relationship for API services while maintaining the legacy foreign key. It includes backfilling existing APIs with primary relations, enforcing unique constraints, and adding domain helpers for better management. The migration ensures that existing functionality remains intact during the transition.

items.title: Enhance Claude and Gemini CLIs with New OpenAPI Features in Clis 🚀
items.summary: This update synchronizes the Claude and Gemini CLIs with the latest OpenAPI specifications. Key enhancements include new chat completion options for Claude and the introduction of native content generation commands for Gemini. These changes improve functionality and user experience by expanding available endpoints and request parameters.

items.title: Enhance USDC Settlement Display in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the display of confirmed x402 USDC settlements by showing exact amounts instead of generic labels. It introduces transaction explorer links, categorizes records by status, and enhances the UI with localized support across 12 languages. Additionally, it addresses potential issues with stale responses and transaction labeling for better user experience.

items.title: Revamp API Token Costs with Protocol-Specific Catalogs in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces separate JsonLogic catalogs for each API protocol, enhancing clarity and precision in token cost calculations. The legacy monolithic catalog is no longer referenced, ensuring all endpoints utilize the new structure. Comprehensive validation confirms the integrity of the changes across all affected components.

items.title: Enhanced USDC Settlement Display in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces the display of confirmed x402 USDC settlements as exact amounts, replacing previous placeholders. It also links supported Solana, Base, and SKALE transactions through a shared CAIP-2 allowlist and improves the distinction between settled, unconfirmed, failed, and legacy payment records. Additionally, payment details are now included in the usage dialog, with localization updates across 18 languages.

items.title: Enhance Usage Billing Alignment in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a canonical internal record structure for usage billing, specifically for Chat Completions, Responses, Messages, and Gemini GenerateContent. Key changes include the normalization of cache write tokens and the capture of detailed usage metrics for Gemini. The public API formats remain unchanged, ensuring compatibility while improving internal processing efficiency.

items.title: Resolve migration conflicts for smoother backend rollout in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new empty merge migration to connect `0269_invoice_public_upload` and `0269_site_logo_variants`, addressing issues that caused the `platform-backend:2942` rollout to crash. The changes ensure that conflicting migrations are resolved, allowing for a stable deployment while maintaining existing traffic. Validation checks confirm that there are no remaining conflicts.

items.title: Enhance x402 Settlement Metadata Tests in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces new tests to verify that API usage lists accurately preserve normalized x402 settlement metadata. Key changes include ensuring atomic USDC amounts are treated as strings and that request/response data remains redacted in list responses while being accessible in detailed views. The tests have passed successfully, confirming the integrity of these functionalities.

items.title: Enhance Payment Settlement Recording in Gateway 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces structured recording of settled usage payments, preserving key details such as the facilitator amount, network, transaction, and payer. Confirmed USDC settlement facts are now stored in `ApiUsage.metadata`, while incomplete successful settlements are marked as `unconfirmed`. Additionally, failed attempts are clearly separated from confirmed transactions, improving overall transaction integrity.

items.title: Enhance Token Formatting with New Helpers in Common Frontend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a precision-safe atomic token formatter for usage history and maps supported CAIP-2 networks to allowlisted transaction explorers. The existing fixed-width token formatter contract has been preserved, and the package has been published as `@acedatacloud/core` version 0.19.1. Comprehensive validation has confirmed the stability and compatibility of these changes.

items.title: Enhance YouTube Skill with Robust Upload Features in Skills 🚀
items.summary: This update strengthens the YouTube skill by ensuring the `publish_artifact` tool remains accessible during uploads. It preserves crucial resumable-init headers and HTTP status codes to accurately report API errors on upload failures. Additionally, new contract tests have been added to ensure the safety of unattended uploads.

items.title: Launch Adaptive Logo Studio for Tenants in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update introduces a two-step workflow for tenant logos, including cropping, analysis, and preview options. It features smart adaptive themes and preserves PNG transparency during cropping. Additionally, the implementation supports translations across 11 locales, enhancing accessibility for diverse users.

items.title: Enhance Logo Processing with New APIs in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces authenticated logo analysis and processing endpoints, enabling the detection of flat backgrounds and the generation of transparent PNG variants. It also enforces upload size limits and persists optional logo variants for better site customization. Comprehensive tests have been added to ensure functionality and reliability.

items.title: Enhance white-label branding for login redirects in Frontend Web 🎨
items.summary: This update implements a robust solution for white-label branding during login redirects by forwarding the current site to AuthFrontend. A new helper function, `withCurrentSite`, is introduced to manage redirect and callback paths while maintaining the platform's branding. Additionally, a prebuild contract check has been added to ensure tenant branding is preserved across all authentication entry points.

items.title: New Invoice Upload Feature for Accountants in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new public upload page for invoices, allowing accountants to upload PDFs without needing a platform admin account. The page is accessible via a unique link that expires after three days, ensuring security and ease of use. Key changes include modifications to routing, API calls, and the addition of necessary UI elements for a seamless user experience.

items.title: Enable Accountant Invoice Upload Without Login in Backend 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a new feature allowing accountants to upload invoices without needing admin credentials. Each pending or processing invoice will generate a temporary upload token valid for three days, streamlining the process and enhancing user experience. The implementation includes robust security measures and ensures that all uploads are properly validated and tracked.

items.title: Streamline White-Label Navigation by Hiding Flagship Links in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update removes flagship links such as platform ranking, connectors, skills, and OAuth apps from the white-label console navigation. It also prevents direct access to the platform ranking admin page and enhances the brand ownership regression check. These changes aim to improve the user experience for white-label sites.

items.title: Streamline Template Creation Process in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update simplifies the automation-template wizard, reducing it from five steps to three: choose, configure, and connect. It also introduces a new mechanism for creating template tasks that are disabled until they are explicitly activated, enhancing user experience and control. Additionally, all 18 locales have been updated to reflect these changes, ensuring consistency across the platform.

items.title: Strengthen Template Activation Checks in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update enforces successful manual-run evidence for every template activation path, ensuring more reliable state updates. Controlled-delivery artifact checks have been applied to both direct state updates and the dedicated enable action. Additionally, the state and template_tested_at are now persisted in a single update for improved efficiency.

items.title: Enhance Console Usage for API Services in Nexior 🚀
items.summary: This update refines the console usage page by limiting it to API services only, removing the obsolete API/Proxy selector. It introduces filters for the API picker and hides usage actions for non-API applications while maintaining global balance usage. Additionally, a new source contract test has been added to ensure the functionality works as intended.

items.title: Enhance Suno Job Handling in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update introduces a mechanism to wait for Suno parent jobs to succeed before proceeding with post-processing tasks. Key changes include the addition of a retry strategy for various operations like WAV and MIDI, ensuring that intermediate job states do not interfere with the processing workflow. The implementation aims to improve reliability and efficiency in handling job responses.

items.title: Enhance Error Handling for Overflow in Platform Service 🚀
items.summary: This update improves the handling of nested prompt-token overflow responses in the github-proxy2. It ensures that the existing HTTP status and error envelope are preserved while providing a clear message for recoverable errors. Additionally, unrelated and malformed errors remain unchanged, enhancing overall error management.

items.title: Upgrade Vite to 8.2.0 in Frontend Web 🚀
items.summary: This update bumps Vite from version 7.3.2 to 8.2.0, bringing several new features and bug fixes. Key improvements include enhanced support for HMR and better handling of worker file updates. The changes are expected to improve the overall development experience and performance of the platform.
